about.en: SIREN is a community memecoin on BNB Smart Chain themed on the sirens of Greek mythology and tied to the SirenAI fortune-telling app at sirenai.me. It was launched through the Four.meme launchpad in February 2025 as a BEP-20 token at 0x997A58129890bbdA032231A52eD1ddC845fc18e1 with a 1,000,000,000 supply. It is unrelated to the earlier Siren options protocol.
